items.stem: In Dynamics 365 Finance, what is the role of a financial dimension?

options.text: An attribute (such as department or cost centre) added to a posting for analysis and reporting
options.rationale: Correct: financial dimensions tag postings so balances can be analysed by department, cost centre and similar attributes.

options.text: A separate legal entity with its own ledger
options.rationale: A legal entity is a distinct company, not a financial dimension.
Exchange rate types govern currency conversion, not dimensional analysis.
Depreciation methods belong to fixed assets, not to the dimension framework.

items.explanation: Correct: financial dimensions tag postings so balances can be analysed by department, cost centre and similar attributes.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about a completed budget register entry are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Its status becomes Completed after budget balances are updated
options.rationale: Correct: updating budget balances moves the entry to Completed.

options.text: It cannot be reopened for edits; a new entry is created to adjust
options.rationale: Correct: a completed entry is locked, so adjustments require a new register entry.

options.text: It automatically posts actual ledger transactions
options.rationale: Budget entries record budget amounts, not actual ledger postings.

options.text: It deletes the prior fiscal year's budget
options.rationale: Completing an entry does not delete other budgets.

items.explanation: Correct: updating budget balances moves the entry to Completed.

items.stem: A purchasing team wants transactions blocked only after a warning when they exceed budget. Which feature supports this?

options.rationale: Correct: budget control issues warnings or errors on documents configured for it.
Fixed asset budgeting plans asset costs, not transaction-level budget checks.
Collection letters chase overdue customer invoices.
Account structures validate account/dimension combinations, not budget funds availability.

items.explanation: Correct: budget control issues warnings or errors on documents configured for it.
